question: If Mimi was pregnant or giving birth, how would the Divine Protection of One-Third handle that? It seems giving birth is painful, so if that was divided up, then her brothers might tread the new frontier of experiencing giving birth despite being male.
answer: If Mimi was to think “Ah, I’ve had enough, Hetaro and Tivey will have to help out!”, those two would also feel the pain of an organ they don’t have.
